notes: Aggregates current successor box-2a capital-gain distribution findings into the family subtotal (ADR-0050 decision 2). Closed-empty publishes zero only through current literal-true closure admitted by the adopted mapping. v2 adds a guard: the rule publishes only when Form 1099-DIV box 2a (f1099div.2a) is closed at the current horizon (require_closed). Why: collect reads closure only when its set is empty; with any member recorded it sums what is present and never asks whether the set is complete, so v1 published a partial capital-gain-distribution subtotal when a family had a recorded amount and an unanswered or stale closure. With the guard, an unclosed family blocks this rule SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED, naming the first unclosed set in the order listed, and every line that reads it waits. A complete return (every family closed at the current horizon, or closed empty) publishes exactly what v1 did. Residual, not closed here: a closure attested true over an amount that was never recorded still publishes the smaller sum, because the engine cannot tell a blank from 'nothing'. Core v66 (itemization-cents, Track 2): this subtotal no longer rounds. It publishes the sum with cents, which is the figure the attachment's itemized rows add to, so the attachment ties out when a member carries cents. The line that reads it rounds once (i1040gi-2025 'Rounding Off to Whole Dollars': include cents when adding amounts and round off only the total). Its closure guard is unchanged.
